snippet.title: Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo - Official Trailer - FGS Live From gamescom latam
snippet.description:
A new trailer for Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo was revealed during FGS Live From gamescom latam, as the first entry in the ‘gamescom latam countdown’ spotlight. You play as a snake, Kulebra, who explores Limbo, a vibrant, Latin American themed afterlife. Use your wits, charm and the odd whack to encourage Limbo’s residents to accept their fate. Developer’s Fellow Traveller announced a release date of May 16, 2025 for adventure game, Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo. Coming to PC, Xbox and Nintendo Switch.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #gamescomlatam
